name: Profile picture
description: Adds a profile picture to every account: the person manages it on My profile, administrators see it in the users list and the user sheet.

profileFields.label: Profile picture
profileFields.help: A png, jpeg or webp image, resized to 256 px, at most 256 KB. Administrators see it but cannot change it: the picture belongs to the person.

sql: create table plg_profile_picture_values (tenant text not null, subject varchar(32) not null, image mediumtext null, primary key (tenant, subject))
